title: Piano Movers in Newport Beach | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Piano moving services in Newport Beach, CA: a crew of 4 on an hourly move, a $200 add-on, and gate, truck and bay-route plans made before move day.
heroSubtitle: Four movers carry your piano on a padded board as part of the hourly move, with the guard gate, the truck spot and the drive across the bay planned ahead.

faq.question: What should I arrange with my guard gate or HOA before the piano move?
faq.answer: Add SOS Moving to the gate list for the move date and ask your association for its move-in and vendor-pass rules. We send back the crew leader's name, the arrival time and the truck plate for the pass. If the association asks for proof of insurance, we issue the certificate for $50.

faq.question: Can the truck get to a house on Balboa Island?
faq.answer: Yes, over the Marine Avenue bridge; the small car ferry is no route for a moving truck. The City notes that larger moving vans do not fit some tight residential streets on the island, so send photos of your street and alley when you book. We plan the truck's stop and the length of the carry from them and include that time in the estimate.

faq.question: How is the piano billed when the rest of the house moves the same day?
faq.answer: The house and the piano share one hourly clock with a crew of four: $199 to $225 an hour depending on the day and how you pay, plus the $200 piano add-on, $30 for gas and a $50 deposit credited to the bill. Addresses 30 or more miles from our Los Angeles base carry a 4-hour minimum, and drive time beyond 10 miles counts double. The office applies both rules to your exact addresses.

faq.question: Can you move my piano today?
faq.answer: Often, yes, if a four-person crew is free. Call 909-443-0004 as early as you can: we work Monday through Sunday, 8AM to 6PM, and the drive from Los Angeles, the carry and the unload all have to fit inside that day.

faq.question: Will you tune the piano afterwards or take away an old one?
faq.answer: No. Our crews only move pianos, so tuning, appraising, repairs, storage and haul-away all sit outside the service we sell. Let the instrument settle into its new room for a while, then book a tuner you trust.
